hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: Each sequence step chooses an integer from 1 to m to contribute to the cumulative sum.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Count how many sequences of length n have an exact sum equal to k.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Transition the count table by advancing the length and maintaining the sum modulo 10^9 + 7.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
def countSequences(n: int, m: int, k: int) -> int:
    MOD = 1_000_000_007
    if k < n or k > n * m:
        return 0
    dp = [0] * (k + 1)
    dp[0] = 1
    for step in range(1, n + 1):
        next_dp = [0] * (k + 1)
        for s in range(step, min(k, step * m) + 1):
            val = 0
            for x in range(1, min(m, s) + 1):
                val = (val + dp[s - x]) % MOD
            next_dp[s] = val
        dp = next_dp
    return dp[k]
```
